claim: Patchline ships a results-never-regress guarantee enforced by the full historical benchmark on every release. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate then re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the never regress claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make historical-results-never-regress-gate`.
